FN-FM4NDCD-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 111
Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development Sponsor: Senator Sam Givhan
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 02/21/2024
Senate Bill 111 as introduced provides for the continuance of the Board of Heating, Air
Conditioning, and Refrigeration Contractors until October 1, 2028 pursuant to the Alabama
Sunset Law. This bill will not otherwise affect state or local funding.
